title: Vocabulary Retention and Mature Cards
dataSources: Lessons (`lesson:complete`), vocab reviews (`vocab:review`), immersion (`immersion:log`), speaking practice (`speaking:session`).
app: Language-learning telemetry — Duolingo / Babbel lesson exports, Anki spaced-repetition review logs, immersion trackers, and speaking-practice logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vocab:review
| stats sum(eval(if(interval_days>=21,1,0))) as mature, count as total, avg(recall_pct) as retention by deck
| eval mature_pct=round(100*mature/total,1)
| sort - mature_pct
description: Tracks how many vocabulary cards have matured into long-term memory and your overall recall rate.
value: Mature-card counts and recall show whether words are truly sticking, not just being crammed and forgotten.
implementation: Ingest Anki review logs into `index=personal`; track mature cards and retention per deck.
visualization: Bar chart of mature-card percentage by deck.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks how many words have moved into long-term memory and how well you remember them.
